title: Rubio Says Cyberattacks Are Not the Cause of Recent Tech Outages
summary_full: Secretary of State Marco Rubio suggested the rush to patch systems, whose vulnerabilities are exposed by A.I., may explain recent failures with air traffic controls, banks and government agencies.
